
## Differential Expression Analysis

Volcano plots show upstream DESeq2 log2 fold changes and -log10(raw P). The direction is Treat relative to Control: positive values indicate upregulation and negative values downregulation. Red and blue mark genes meeting both configured P and absolute log2FC cutoffs; gray marks the remainder. Dashed lines show cutoffs.

Raw-P classification is distinct from FDR control. Original pvalue and padj values are retained. A display cap, where used, clips only the plotted coordinates. Preview tables and labels identify significant genes; complete records remain in the input files.

```{python}
#| label: pdf-deg
#| output: asis
from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import raw_probability_columns
if not comparisons:
    typst_note('No valid comparisons; differential expression plots are omitted.')
for comp in comparisons:
    path = get_file_path(config, f'{comp}_DEG.csv', local_base_dir=deg_base_dir)
    if not path or not os.path.isfile(path):
        raise FileNotFoundError(f'Missing DEG result: {comp}')
    frame = pd.read_csv(path)
    annotated_frame = apply_gene_annotation(frame, project_info)
    fc = deg_settings.get('log2fc_threshold', 1.0)
    p = deg_settings.get('pvalue_threshold', 0.05)
    up, down = deg_counts(frame, fc, p)
    volcano_settings = project_info.get('analysis', {}).get('volcano', {})
    cap = volcano_settings.get('y_axis', {}).get('display_cap', 50)
    annotate_top = volcano_settings.get('annotate_top', 5)
    fig = plot_volcano_pvalue(annotated_frame, title='', col_logfc='log2FoldChange', col_pval='pvalue', col_padj='padj', col_symbol='Symbol', fc_cutoff=fc, pval_cutoff=p, display_cap=cap, annotate_top=annotate_top)
    show_figure(fig, evidence={'kind': 'deg', 'comparison': comp, 'up': up, 'down': down}, caption=f'{comp} Differential Expression Volcano Plot. Treat relative to Control; upregulated on the right and downregulated on the left; raw P < {p} and |Log2FC| > {fc}. Upregulated {up}, downregulated {down}. Plotted -log10(P) is capped at {cap} (top label: {cap}+); original pvalue/padj values are retained. The top {annotate_top} significant genes per direction have leader-line labels.')
    typst_note(f'{comp}: upregulated {up}, downregulated {down}; remaining records do not meet both cutoffs.')
    display_result_ai(f'rna.results.deg__{comp}')
    frame = gene_columns(apply_gene_annotation(raw_probability_columns(path, frame), project_info))
    per_direction = max(1, pdf_settings.get('deg_rows', 10) // 2)
    for direction, mask in [('Up', frame['log2FoldChange'].gt(fc)), ('Down', frame['log2FoldChange'].lt(-fc))]:
        selected = mask & pd.to_numeric(frame['pvalue'], errors='coerce').lt(p)
        display(Markdown(f'### {comp} Top {per_direction} {direction}\n'))
        preview(frame.loc[selected], path, sort_by='pvalue', limit=per_direction, caption=f'{comp} {direction} Differential Gene Preview', columns=['Gene ID', 'Symbol', 'log2FoldChange', 'pvalue', 'padj'], evidence={'kind': 'deg', 'comparison': comp, 'direction': direction})
```
